summary: atip.codesplit.07 Then still promises "plugin sync, which takes no index lock, is not refused for a lock another process holds", but its bound test atip_codesplit_07_a_file_or_lock_the_system_refuses_is_told_by_the_code_of_its_own_subject (tests/atip_codesplit.rs:324) never runs plugin sync; that leg is asserted only by atip_codesplit_04_..., which is bound to atip.codesplit.04. Fix: drop the clause from .07 (it belongs to .04) or bind the .04 case to .07 as well. (spec fidelity, r3 reword left it as is)
